name: Cryogenic preconcentration of whole-air volatile organic compounds
plain_name: Trap trace air pollutants before GC-MS
description: Trace-air analytical system with cold trapping and hot desorption; it does not expose a bulk experiment to the trap's entire thermal cycle.
keywords: Trap trace air pollutants before GC-MS

requirements.rationale: The procedure requires gas traps and programmed cryofocusing,not a generic cold sample chamber.
An interfaced GC-MSD is explicitly part of the actual research system.
Module3 precool is-180 C in the selected long-method screenshot.
Module3 injection setting is80 C; desorption is part of the same trap method.

missing_information: This is the EPA's internal laboratory research SOP,not an officially approved EPA method or a guarantee of regulatory method compliance.
Calibration,recovery,water removal and detection limits require the method's separate QC; no fake chromatogram is generated.
confirmation_note: Source-specific requirements reviewed by the catalog author on 2026-10-31. They describe the selected procedure, not a universal limit. Users must confirm them before a run; edits require confirmation again.
